name: Sepulchrine-Vanguard
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past solar wind erosion patterns, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on copper, silicon, rare flora and titanium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
